description:
Perform a retrospective chart review of a surgical case using Vital Recorder. 

Goal: Open the surgical case file '0006.vital' and document specific vital signs at 5-minute intervals into a summary text file.

Instructions:
1. Open Vital Recorder (if not already open).
2. Load the file '0006.vital' located at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\VitalData\0006.vital'.
3. You must read values for three parameters: Heart Rate (HR), SpO2, and Systolic Blood Pressure (ART_SBP or SBP).
4. Navigate to the specific timestamps listed below and record the values displayed at that exact moment:
   - 00:10:00 (10 minutes)
   - 00:15:00 (15 minutes)
   - 00:20:00 (20 minutes)
   - 00:25:00 (25 minutes)
   - 00:30:00 (30 minutes)

5. Create a text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\vitals_summary.txt' with the following exact format (replace <value> with the integer number you read):

INTRAOPERATIVE VITAL SIGNS SUMMARY
Case: 0006
Period: 00:10:00 - 00:30:00

Time,HR,SpO2,SBP
00:10:00,<value>,<value>,<value>
00:15:00,<value>,<value>,<value>
00:20:00,<value>,<value>,<value>
00:25:00,<value>,<value>,<value>
00:30:00,<value>,<value>,<value>

If a value is not available/blank at a timestamp, write 'N/A'. Round values to the nearest whole number.
